description_expanded: Overview5.0(19 reviews)Overlooks Lagoon Pool - 4 Bikes - Private Beach- 5 Minute Walk `Sand Dollar Getaway`The Space Poolside Paradise – Luxury Seacrest Condo with Lagoon Pool Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Lagoon Pool Front Condo – Overlooks the largest & best pool on 30A! Private 3rd-Floor Access via Elevator – Exclusive & convenient entrance 5-Minute Walk to the Beach – Or enjoy FREE golf cart tram service in season! Spacious Patio Overlooking Pool – Relax & soak up the stunning views 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach & 30A trails Flat Panel TVs Throughout – Entertainment in every room High-Speed Secured Wi-Fi – Stay connected while you unwind 2 Designated Parking Spots – Limited overflow available Walk to Shops & Restaurants – Located near Alys Beach & Rosemary Beach Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacationWelcome to Sand Dollar GetawayLagoon Pool Front Seacrest condo rental! Poolside... Plus only a 5 Minute stroll to the beach! (With free Deluxe Golf Cart tram service in season to carry all of your beach gear!) Relax on the fabulous deck overlooking the best pool on 30A. Arrive by elevator to your private entrance of this 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath condominium. Your vacation paradise occupies the entire third floor of the building.Great views from the third floor!!!Swim in the awesome lagoon pool, enjoy the beaches, ride the 30A bike trail, walk to the shops and restaurants of Alys and Rosemary Beach and take advantage of the many unique FREE family activities nearby.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (9):Master Bedroom: King Sized bed, private bathroom with rain shower and an air jet tubGuest Bedroom: King size bed, private bathroom with walk in shower, BalconyGuest Bedroom: Queen sized bed, shared bathroom, BalconyGuest Bedroom: Bunk bed; twin over full, shared bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​Show less
